title: alchemilla arvensis subsp. microcarpa
intro: Alchemilla arvensis subsp. microcarpa, commonly known as the small-fruited lady's mantle, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce symptoms of digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Alchemilla arvensis subsp. microcarpa include its ability to protect the mucous membranes, soothe digestive issues, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, tannins, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
